critical_code_review_comments: verify_image_magic_bytes correctly special-cases WEBP with the two-window check (RIFF at 0-4 AND WEBP at 8-12) — the trivially-forged 'RIFFxxxxWEBP...' would still pass, but that's the standard tradeoff for magic-byte sniffing and the current impl matches the file format spec.
applications.py: 'if not auto_approved' branch wraps send_application_received_email in try/except and only logs on failure — matches the spec 'never let email block application submission'. Good.
AddProduct.js: sensible extraction — parent stays under 175 lines and hands form state to each of the 4 sub-components. No prop-drilling smell.
MyListings.js at 448 lines is still on the heavier side; consider splitting the ActiveList and DeadStockList blocks into their own components in a future pass — but no functional regression.

AdminDashboard: risk-score sort is server-side (routes/applications.py sort([('risk_score',-1),('created_at',-1)])), so the frontend AdminApplicationsPanel just renders in the received order. Good separation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 4 refactored pages render and interact with zero errors)
